ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the diagram is a schematic diagram of the material cycle of the lithosphere, containing boxes such as "igneous rock", "sedimentary rock", "metamorphic rock", and "magma". Number ② is marked beside the arrow pointing to "sedimentary rock", indicating the process by which other rocks form sedimentary rock after undergoing a certain action. Then reason: sedimentary rock is usually formed from pre-existing rocks through external force processes such as weathering, erosion, transport, deposition, and consolidation into rock, so ② in the diagram represents external force action.
